content:
Hi

Are you able to provide the below configuration information. This will help diagnose why your account fails to connect to the server.

For example, The mobile app doesn't support oAuth + pop3 protocol which the desktop version does.

  1. What does the error message say exactly when the connection is rejected?
  2. Who is your email provider?
  3. What connection type are you using (Imap or pop3)?
  4. What authentication method are you using (Oauth 2.0, App password, account username/password)?
  5. What server name and port number is being used for Imap/pop3 and SMTP?

You can find these settings under:

  1. Settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server.
  2. Settings > account name > sending mail > outgoing server.

It's normally sufficient for the QR code to successfully scan when visible within the camera viewfinder. You don't normally need to zoom or align the image.

In the meantime, you can add your accounts using Thunderbird androids setup wizard rather scanning a QR code.

content:
For Thunderbird desktop specific support, you would be better asking within the desktop forum.

On the mobile front, you can enable debug logging to see what's happening in the background. Navigate to settings > general settings > debugging. See guide here.

The mobile app doesn't have any filtering at all (blocking, spam or rule based).

You indicate settings are correct. Have you changed any settings from their default values within settings > account > fetching mail?

For example, having a local folder size set high is known to cause performance issues as noted by developers on github here.
